findings.title: align-items mixin passes the modern keyword to legacy and non-existent properties
findings.body: The mixin writes the same `$alignment` value into `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`. Those legacy syntaxes use different keywords: `start` and `end` instead of `flex-start` and `flex-end`. Any caller passing `flex-start` or `flex-end` would get an invalid declaration, which is silently dropped, so the prefixed fallback does nothing. `-ms-align-items` is not a real property at all. Current callers use only `center` and `baseline`, so nothing breaks today. The mixin is still unsafe as a general-purpose helper, and line 120 has trailing whitespace.

findings.title: Inconsistent default ordering between legacy and modern flexbox for the header
findings.body: `.panel` gets `order(3)`, which emits `-webkit-box-ordinal-group: 3`. Its siblings in the header, such as the logo/title, have no explicit order. Old `-webkit-box` ordinal groups default to 1, while the modern `order` default is 0. On browsers that use the legacy syntax, the relative order of items with and without an explicit value can therefore differ from modern browsers. This is minor, but the fallback prefixes give a false sense of cross-browser parity.

findings.title: small-action layout rewritten with a percentage padding and removed spacing
findings.body: `.small-action` becomes a flex container. The `.small-action-desc` padding is changed from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%`, and `margin-top: 5px` is removed. Inner paragraph margins and padding are also zeroed. This changes the vertical spacing and the avatar-to-text gap of every small-action post (closed, pinned, and similar). The gap now varies with container width instead of being fixed, so it can look wrong on narrow or mobile layouts. Floats on `.topic-avatar`, `.avatar` and `button`, plus the leftover `clear: both`, are now redundant or conflicting inside a flex container. There is no evidence that mobile or other overriding stylesheets were checked.

findings.title: Removed bullet badge margin and added line-height without compensating alignment
findings.body: The `.badge-wrapper.bullet { margin-top: 5px }` rule is removed from `.extra-info-wrapper`, and `line-height: 1.5` and `order(2)` are added. `order` only has an effect if `.extra-info-wrapper` is a direct child of the new flex container `.d-header .contents`, which this PR does not show. The bullet badge's vertical alignment now depends on the inline-flex baseline alignment in `badges.css.scss` plus the new line-height. That may shift the badge relative to the title, and nothing verifies it.
